optionDescriptions.toggleCode: Toggles inline code on the selection.
optionDescriptions.setColor: Sets the text colour; `null` removes it (R14).
optionDescriptions.setBackgroundColor: Sets the highlight colour; `null` removes it.
optionDescriptions.setFontFamily: Sets the font family; `null` removes it.
optionDescriptions.setFontSize: Sets the font size; `null` removes it.
optionDescriptions.clearFormatting: Removes marks, and optionally block formatting.
optionDescriptions.setBlockType: Turns the block into a paragraph, heading, quote or code block.
optionDescriptions.setAlign: Aligns the block; 'left' is the default (R6).
optionDescriptions.indent: Indents the block or list item.
optionDescriptions.outdent: Outdents the block or list item.
optionDescriptions.toggleBulletList: Turns the selection into a bulleted list.
optionDescriptions.toggleOrderedList: Turns the selection into a numbered list.
optionDescriptions.toggleCheckList: Turns the selection into a check list.
optionDescriptions.updateLink: Updates the link at the selection.
optionDescriptions.removeLink: Removes the link, keeping the text.
optionDescriptions.addRowBefore: Adds a row above the current one.
optionDescriptions.addRowAfter: Adds a row below the current one.
optionDescriptions.addColumnBefore: Adds a column before the current one.
optionDescriptions.addColumnAfter: Adds a column after the current one.
optionDescriptions.toggleHeaderRow: Turns the first row into a header row.
optionDescriptions.insertLineBreak: Inserts a line break inside the block.
optionDescriptions.insertMergeTag: Inserts a merge tag as one atomic node (R23).
optionDescriptions.insertText: Inserts plain text at the selection.
optionDescriptions.insertHTML: Inserts sanitized HTML at the selection.
optionDescriptions.insertContent: Inserts a value in any supported format.
optionDescriptions.focusStart: Moves the caret to the start.
optionDescriptions.focusEnd: Moves the caret to the end.
optionDescriptions.toggleSourceView: Shows or hides the HTML source view.
